sources.title: Neural Additive Models: Interpretable Machine Learning with Neural Nets
sources.scope: Official proceedings abstract read. Direct prior art for a sum of one-input neural subnetworks as an additive structural restriction.

sources.title: Identifying Representations for Intervention Extrapolation
sources.scope: Official conference abstract read. Direct prior art that unseen-intervention extrapolation requires identifiable representation plus explicit structural assumptions.

sources.title: Lipschitz verification of neural networks through training
sources.authors: Simon Kuang; Yuezhu Xu; S. Sivaranjani; Xinfan Lin
sources.scope: ArXiv abstract read. Used only for current prior-art context that cheap layerwise/global Lipschitz bounds can be loose and architecture can be designed for verifiability.

sources.title: Training Certifiably Robust Neural Networks with Efficient Local Lipschitz Bounds
sources.scope: Abstract read. Used for established distinction between loose global Lipschitz bounds and tighter local certification.

novelty_status: Strong prior art for additive architectures, intervention extrapolation and Lipschitz certification. R99 is a project-specific synthesis and finite audit; no historical-first claim.
